title: GET /api/learn/rehearsal?app=&board= : what the chat reads under the indexing shimmer and during a rehearsal
description: The control plane's answer for a canvas whose project is a repository. `catalogue` is the catalogue's state (queued while the snapshot is indexing or the catalogue runs, ready, failed) with `practicalRoutes`, so the Tutor's first line already knows can or cannot; `routes` lists, per routeId that has been started or has a record, its rehearsal state (the schemas/status.json states plus `none`), so the chat can say the API route is already rehearsed. `record` is present only when a routeId is asked for with `&routeId=` and its record is ready (schemas/record.json). POST /api/learn/rehearsal takes {app, board, action: 'catalogue'} (start or return the cached catalogue; answers this shape with `catalogueDoc` when ready) or {app, board, action: 'start', routeId} (start that route's rehearsal; answers the status shape as today). Wording of every Tutor line built from this is in cannot-run-edge-cases.md section 1a: never a stack trace, sandbox id, dollar figure or Modal term.

indexing.description: the repository import's own state, when the chat asks before it is ready

error.description: a plain reason for the Tutor's sentence, never a stack trace

learn.description: present only while a stored catalogue document has no `learn` section yet: queued (the additive call is running or waiting) or failed (it made none; the Tutor says so)

catalogueDoc.description: present when catalogue.status is ready and the caller asked for it (POST action catalogue)
